news.title: Two Blues shortlisted for Premier League Player of the Month award
news.title_zh: 两名蓝军入围英超本月最佳球员奖
news.body_en: Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro have both been nominated for the August EA Sports Premier League Player of the Month award. The two forwards have started the 2026/27 season in great form, alongside summer signing Morgan Rogers, in Xabi Alonso’s three-pronged attack. In our opening two Premier League fixtures – against Fulham and Brighton and Hove Albion – Joao Pedro and Palmer registered seven goal involvements between them. Vote for Joao Pedro and Cole Palmer to win Premier League Player of the Month! Joao Pedro made a flying start to the campaign at Fulham, scoring after just 33 seconds following a neat flick from Palmer. The Brazil international then returned the favour, setting up Palmer to score our winner at Craven Cottage from a tight angle. The pair were at it again last weekend, as we hosted Brighton in our first Premier League home fixture.  Joao Pedro netted our third in the 4-3 victory with a tidy finish before teeing up Cole for his stunning dribble and strike to seal the win. Voting for the August Premier League Player of the Month award is open now, and you can cast yours for the two nominated Blues here until midday on Monday 7 September. The winner will be announced at 11am on Friday 11 September. The other players on the eight-man shortlist are: Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal), Rayan Cherki (Manchester City), Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), Mamadou Sangare (Brentford), Konstantinos Tzolakis (Hull City) and Yoane Wissa (Newcastle United).
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 和若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 均获得 EA 体育英超联赛 8 月最佳球员奖提名。这两名前锋在哈维·阿隆索的三管齐下的进攻中，与夏季签约的摩根·罗杰斯一起以出色的状态开始了2026/27赛季。在我们开场的两场英超比赛中——对阵富勒姆、布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩——若昂·佩德罗和帕尔默共打进了七个进球。投票给若奥·佩德罗和科尔·帕尔默赢得本月英超最佳球员！若昂·佩德罗在对阵富勒姆的比赛中取得了开门红，仅仅 33 秒后，帕尔默的一脚漂亮的射门就进球了。这位巴西国脚随后也做出了回应，帮助帕尔默在克雷文小屋的小角度攻入制胜球。上周末，我们在首场英超主场比赛中主场迎战布莱顿，两人再次相遇。  若昂·佩德罗以漂亮的射门打进了我们的第三个球，以 4-3 的比分获胜，随后科尔以惊人的运球和射门锁定胜局。八月份英超联赛月度最佳球员奖的投票现已开放，您可以在 9 月 7 日星期一中午之前为两名提名的蓝军投票。获胜者将于 9 月 11 日星期五上午 11 点公布。八人候选名单上的其他球员包括：里卡多·卡拉菲奥里（阿森纳）、拉扬·切尔基（曼城）、布鲁诺·费尔南德斯（曼联）、马马杜·桑加雷（布伦特福德）、康斯坦丁诺斯·佐拉基斯（赫尔城）和约阿内·维萨（纽卡斯尔联）。

news.title: Chelsea Star of the Match against Real Sociedad revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西对阵皇家社会的比赛之星揭晓！
news.body_en: The votes have been counted and we can now reveal the player named Chelsea Star of the Match after our 1-0 UEFA Champions League qualifying victory over Real Sociedad on Wednesday. The Blues built on our 5-2 first-leg advantage by winning 1-0 at Estadio Zubieta in San Sebastian last night, with Keira Walsh finding the net for Sonia Bompastor's side. That secured our qualification for this season's Women's Champions League proper, with the league phase draw taking place tomorrow (Friday) morning. And supporters on the Chelsea Official App selected goalscorer Walsh as the star performer on the night, with the midfielder picking up 54 per cent of the votes. Ellie Carpenter, who put in a solid display down the right-hand side, came in second place with a 31 per cent share of the voting. Be there to welcome CFCW to our new home at Stamford Bridge when we take on Aston Villa in our first Women's Super League match of the season on 5 September at 12.35pm!
news.body_zh: 计票已经完成，周三我们在欧冠资格赛中 1-0 战胜皇家社会后，我们现在可以揭晓切尔西本场比赛之星的球员了。昨晚，蓝军在圣塞巴斯蒂安的苏比埃塔体育场以 5-2 的优势取得胜利，凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 为索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 的球队攻入一球。这确保了我们获得本赛季女子冠军联赛的参赛资格，联赛阶段抽签将在明天（周五）早上进行。切尔西官方应用程序上的支持者将进球者沃尔什选为当晚表现最佳的中场球员，这位中场球员获得了 54% 的选票。埃莉·卡彭特（Ellie Carpenter）在右侧表现出色，以 31% 的得票率位居第二。 9 月 5 日中午 12 点 35 分，我们将在本赛季首场女子超级联赛对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中欢迎 CFCW 来到我们位于斯坦福桥的新家！

news.body_en: Details have been announced on the loyalty points required by members wishing to access ticket sales for this month's west London derby. Chelsea travel to Brentford’s Gtech Community Stadium for a league encounter on Friday 18 September. The match kicks off and 8pm and ticket sales will be as follows: As tickets for this match are being sold on a loyalty-point basis and the match takes place in the first month of the season, loyalty points accrued during the previous season will be taken into account. Thursday 3 September from 10am until 11:30am: Tickets will be sold to members with 149 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Thursday 3 September from 12pm until 1:30pm: Tickets will be sold to members with 144 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Thursday 3 September from 2pm until 3.30pm: Tickets will be sold to members with 139 loyalty points or more who can purchase one ticket per person. Thursday 3 September from 4pm: All remaining members who have yet to purchase can purchase one ticket per person. Tickets will be sold online only. Supporters who require accessible tickets can submit an application form found here during the selling period. Alternatively, supporters if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) to reserve tickets and request further information. Personal assistant tickets can only be allocated using this process. We have received an allocation of 1,725 tickets which includes an allocation of 14 non-ambulant and 14 personal assistant tickets. Ambulant tickets will be taken from the main allocation. The entire allocation for this fixture will be in sent in the post, via first class delivery. Tickets will be sent from the week commencing Monday 7 September. Supporters who do not receive their tickets should email the ticket office on Friday 18 September no later than 12pm. Please note that away duplicate tickets can only be collected by supporters in the booking. Loyalty points will continue to be awarded for purchasing away tickets. If purchasing on the away ticket exchange, points will remain with the original purchaser and additionally be awarded to the new ticket holder. If using away ticket transfer, points will remain with the original ticket purchaser. Supporters will receive three loyalty points for this match. For the 2026/27 season, away ticket holders will only be able to pass on their ticket to an existing eligible member/season ticket holder who does not already have a ticket for this fixture. When doing so, they will be required to provide the name and membership number of the supporter who is using the ticket to the club via an online form. The form will be active on Monday 14 September from 12pm, to access the form, please click here. Away ticket holders will be able to transfer their ticket up to six times per season. Digital and in-person spot checks will be carried out to ensure the correct information has been provided to the club. For the 2026/27 season Chelsea FC may, at our discretion, make away match tickets for Premier League matches available to sell and be purchased on the ticket exchange. More information will be provided once the sales process is completed. Away match tickets are not refundable.
